'''Miko''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Esaga sector/Legends|Esaga sector]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] of the planet were known to wear a unique gear in addition using the unique pulsing [[Crystal/Legends|crystals]] to produce powerful [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsabers]].
